patterns.name: catalog_hash_mismatch_stale_denominator
patterns.signature: Catalog hash MISMATCH for {family}: current={hash_a}... denominator={hash_b}...
patterns.root_cause: Denominator file api_catalog_sha256 was set to a hash from a prior catalog generation (2242abba) while the new run produced a different catalog hash (402ddee5). The pipeline uses strict catalog hash validation to prevent stale-catalog generation.
patterns.resolution: Update denominator api_catalog_sha256 to match the current run's catalog hash. Verify with compute_catalog_hash() function.
patterns.prevention: Always update api_catalog_sha256 in denominator file when adding new types to allowed_types or after package version changes.

patterns.name: missing_namespace_using_directive_textfragment
patterns.signature: PDF: uses TextFragment but is missing 'using Aspose.Pdf.Text;' directive
patterns.root_cause: LLM generates code using TextFragment (from Aspose.Pdf.Text namespace) in fixture creation but omits the required 'using Aspose.Pdf.Text;' directive. TextFragment lives in Aspose.Pdf.Text, not in Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.
patterns.resolution: Add REQUIRED constraint: 'REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf.Text; (for TextFragment fixture creation)'
patterns.prevention: All PDF types that use programmatic fixture creation must include Aspose.Pdf.Text as REQUIRED using directive in per_type_constraints.

patterns.name: non_existent_datasources_subnamespace
patterns.signature: PDF: uses 'using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.DataSources;' — this sub-namespace does NOT exist
patterns.root_cause: LLM hallucinates a sub-namespace 'Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.DataSources' that does not exist. FileDataSource lives in 'Aspose.Pdf.LowCode' directly.
patterns.resolution: FORBIDDEN constraint: 'FORBIDDEN: using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.DataSources — sub-namespace does not exist'
patterns.prevention: Include in PDF global FORBIDDEN list. Already partially handled by validator.

patterns.name: wrong_options_class_pdf_aconverter
patterns.signature: PDF: uses 'new PluginOptions()' — PluginOptions is abstract
patterns.root_cause: LLM did not know the concrete options class name PdfAConvertOptions. It defaulted to PluginOptions (abstract), LowCodeLoadOptions, or LowCodeSaveOptions — all wrong. The class PdfAConvertOptions is the correct concrete options class for PdfAConverter.
patterns.resolution: Add REQUIRED: 'REQUIRED: new PdfAConvertOptions( — use PdfAConvertOptions as the concrete options class (NOT PluginOptions)'. Also add FORBIDDEN for LowCodeLoadOptions, LowCodeSaveOptions, new PluginOptions().
patterns.prevention: For any new PDF LowCode type, explicitly name the concrete options class in REQUIRED constraints. LLM cannot infer options class names from type names alone.

patterns.name: merger_repair_regression_lost_addinput
patterns.signature: PDF: missing AddInput() call — options must have AddInput(new FileDataSource(...))
patterns.root_cause: When LLM repaired the 'using Aspose.Pdf.Text;' constraint issue for Merger, it accidentally dropped the AddInput() call from the options setup. The repair prompt only had the TextFragment constraint but not the AddInput/AddOutput/MergeOptions constraints.
patterns.resolution: Add all critical structural constraints as REQUIRED so they survive repair: MergeOptions class, AddInput, AddOutput. Repair prompts re-inject all REQUIRED constraints.
patterns.prevention: Every non-trivial structural pattern must be a REQUIRED constraint, not just the failing constraint. Repair re-injects all REQUIRED constraints.

patterns.name: splitter_textfragment_non_deterministic_fixture
patterns.signature: Splitter generates TextFragment fixture but missing 'using Aspose.Pdf.Text;' not in REQUIRED for Splitter
patterns.root_cause: LLM non-deterministically adds TextFragment to Splitter fixture creation (to add content to the page before splitting). When this happens without the TextFragment constraint, validation fails. The Splitter REQUIRED constraints did not include 'using Aspose.Pdf.Text;' initially.
patterns.resolution: Add 'REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf.Text; (for TextFragment fixture creation)' to Splitter per_type_constraints.
patterns.prevention: Any PDF type whose fixture creation may non-deterministically use TextFragment must have the Text namespace as REQUIRED.

patterns.name: words_mailmerger_insertfield_constraint_extraction
patterns.signature: Missing required LowCode API call: REQUIRED: template DOCX created with MERGEFIELD fields via DocumentBuilder.InsertField
patterns.root_cause: Initial REQUIRED constraint was 'REQUIRED: template DOCX created with MERGEFIELD fields via DocumentBuilder.InsertField("MERGEFIELD FieldName")'. The constraint extraction logic split on '(' to get token, yielding 'REQUIRED: template DOCX created with MERGEFIELD fields via DocumentBuilder.InsertField' — but LLM used 'InsertField' without the full context.
patterns.resolution: Simplify the REQUIRED constraint to use a shorter, unambiguous token: 'REQUIRED: InsertField("MERGEFIELD — create MERGEFIELD fields in template via DocumentBuilder.InsertField'. Token extracts as 'InsertField' which is present in correct code.
patterns.prevention: REQUIRED constraints must have a simple, unambiguous first token that the LLM will include verbatim. Avoid complex tokens with multiple quoted strings.

patterns.name: processor_api_access_paradox
patterns.signature: CS0120: An object reference is required for the non-static field/method/property 'Processor.From(string)'
patterns.root_cause: Aspose.Words.LowCode.Processor has 0 public constructors (cannot call new Processor()) and all methods (From, To, Execute) are instance methods (cannot call statically). This creates an API access paradox: no way to obtain a Processor instance from user code.
patterns.resolution: Processor removed from pilot allowed_types. Requires ProcessorContext factory investigation or Aspose.Words version upgrade that adds public constructor or static factory.
patterns.prevention: Check constructors: [] in catalog for any new type before adding to allowed_types. Types with 0 constructors and all instance methods are inaccessible.

patterns.name: lowcode_load_save_options_wrong_for_pdfaconverter
patterns.root_cause: LLM used LowCodeLoadOptions/LowCodeSaveOptions as input/output option containers instead of PdfAConvertOptions. These are generic base classes, not the correct concrete options for PdfAConverter.
patterns.resolution: Add FORBIDDEN constraints for both LowCodeLoadOptions and LowCodeSaveOptions in PdfAConverter per_type_constraints.
patterns.prevention: When a type has a unique concrete options class, always add FORBIDDEN for the commonly hallucinated generic alternatives.
